design.TT: actual target AGRI, actual-time frozen-R COT
design.FT: SimVP forecast AGRI, actual-time frozen-R COT
design.TF: actual target AGRI, SimVP forecast AGRI -> frozen R COT
design.FF: SimVP forecast AGRI and its frozen-R COT

upstream_bank_selection: all monthly-split validation windows, independent of CPP support; CPP is not used for filtering or scoring
interpretation: All arms use the same fixed seed42 AC head; TT is oracle same-time reference, FF is a fixed-head operational-input replay but not a trained forecast-GHI head or publication score. Results are bounded validation diagnostics, not a deployable forecast-GHI score.
